briefdescription.para: Approximation boundary and governance rules for layered retrieval (EPIC 2.4).

detaileddescription.para: Defines the typed contract for approximation zones per retrieval layer, governance decisions, exactness violations, and the rule-engine interface used by the hybrid query planner to enforce policy at runtime.

listitem.para: Category C operations (ACL, provenance, transactions) are always ApproximationZone::Exact. Any routing attempt to Approximate or Bounded is fail-closed (GovernanceDecision::Deny).
Truth-bearing queries must use RetrievalLayer::ExactGraph or RetrievalLayer::DistributedShard with exact-on-demand active.
Advisory queries may use any zone; the cheapest eligible zone is preferred.
The policy version is attached to every decision for provenance tracing.
Bypass is only permitted when ApproximationPolicy::allow_bypass is true and is propagated as an audit note in BoundaryCheckResult.

simplesect.para: Status: Phases 1-7 complete (contract, implementation, error handling, tests, performance, documentation, integration).
